reason: The cited lines show an axios POST to an extract endpoint with params/API key and returning response.data, plus formatting returned URL/content/raw_content. They do not show arbitrary host code execution. They do not establish access to non-public host files, localhost/intranet, databases, or credentialed SaaS data. The outbound POST is to this.baseURLs.extract rather than an agent-chosen URL/host, and a fixed vendor-style endpoint is not a SINK from these lines alone. The returned result content/raw_content derived from supplied URLs is web/extracted content and can be attacker-controlled, so UNTRUSTED is supported.
